cover.lead_head_html: Sixty-four years ago this week, a grapefruit of transistors taught the world to watch itself live.
cover.standfirst: Telstar 1 lasted seven months. The signal it opened never closed — and you can still hear it in a synth line and a World Cup beamed from another continent.
